description: Mongo Q1 (spec 3.1): the revert rate by hour of day (UTC, hour of the edit) and user kind (bot, temporary = logged out, registered, unknown), for both cohorts. History cohort: reverted = history.reverted (reverted within 20 days, self-reverts included). Live cohort: reverted = a revert_links document (found with $lookup) with within_followup (within 4 days). The live half is added with $unionWith, so the $lookup runs only for live documents. Output: cohort, hour_utc, user_kind, edits, reverted, revert_rate. How to run it by hand: in Atlas, open Data Explorer, pick the database 'truthlag' and the collection 'revisions', open the Aggregations tab, switch to the text view (the '</>' button) and paste the 'pipeline' array. In MongoDB Compass: open the collection 'revisions', Aggregations, Text, then paste the array. In mongosh: db.revisions.aggregate(<pipeline>). Do not edit this file by hand: queries/run_mongo.py writes it from config.py.
